item.title: Israel Weapons Industry Expands Counter-Drone Footprint into Southeast Asia
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Thailand's deployment of IWI's ARBEL counter-drone system marks a major shift in Southeast Asian defense modernization as tactical UAV threats surge.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Four additional Southeast Asian militaries are currently advancing through various stages of the ARBEL procurement process. [SPLIT] ⚡ The ARBEL system functions by replacing the lower receiver of standard infantry rifles, offering a cost-effective upgrade path without necessitating total inventory replacement. item.title: Thales Secures US Navy Deal to Automate Mine Countermeasures
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The US Navy is leaning hard into autonomous mine countermeasures. Thales subsidiary Advanced Acoustic Concepts just landed a $53.9M deal integrating the SAMDIS 600 sonar and HII's REMUS 620 UUV to keep sailors out of the strike zone.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The core technology relies on Thales' SAMDIS 600 three-beam sonar, which drastically reduces false positives via multi-angle imaging. [SPLIT] ⚡ Unmanned integration pairs the sonar payload with HII's REMUS 620 UUV and Sea Launcher systems for autonomous launch, search, and recovery.
